column3: goto L from a nested block
column4: A GOTO whose label is owned by an enclosing block charges THAT block's pad and saved-SP cell, resolves through the scope chain, and emits LHLD cell / SPHL / CALL ?RECOV / JMP L; intermediate blocks get neither.

column3: goto L in the same block
column4: A GOTO to a label owned by the referencing block emits a direct JMP and creates NO recovery pad and NO saved-SP cell, even when that label is also an ON-GOTO target in the same block.

column3: same label name at two levels
column4: A nested procedure may define a label with the same name as one in its enclosing block, so resolution must key on (name, owning scope): a name-only forward slot lets the inner definition answer an outer reference, which compiles and differs by one address.
